comparison.objective: Bimanually lift, shake, and replace a soil-filled sieve while separating soil from retained pebbles; unlike adjusting and commissioning a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Opposed-handle grasping, level bimanual load support, coordinated circular shaking, and controlled replacement; no tool alignment, threaded unlocking/locking, fine rotary setting, or iterative impact tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Sift enough of 72 rigid crumbs into the tub, retain every pebble, and return the sieve to its battens; stated tiers are 18, 36, or 50 crumbs depending on stage, with any pebble in the tub causing failure. No spec versions were supplied, and damage/drop thresholds beyond pebble loss are unspecified.
comparison.reason: The task tests sustained bimanual transport and selective particle separation, not precision tool use, retention torque, or dynamic-response commissioning.
